rules.behavior: material.requires_tool || block.minHarvestLevel(metadata)>0
held strength<1 recursively calculates empty-hand strength; required tool then strength=0, otherwise 1
material minimum 0 stays 0; metal uses minimum; other material minimum-1
matching material OR matching block AND sufficient tier; sandstone-model slab plus axe has an earlier exception (aqz.V is sandstone ID 24, aqz.java:2284)
strength=minimumStrength=4*hardness before all later modifiers; zero hardness earlier returns 1
positive efficiency enchantment level adds level*level+1 only on effective held-item branch

ineffective web *=0.2; haste *=1+(amplifier+1)*0.2; fatigue *=1-(amplifier+1)*0.2; underwater without aqua-affinity, airborne, and no food energy each independently /=5; final *=1+level*0.02, lower bounded by portable minimum
negative hardness/nonpositive strength gives 0; zero hardness instant; relative=hardness/strength; relative<0.0029296875 instant; otherwise progress=1/relative/512
old tryHarvestBlock removes block before checking positive strength for drops; modern implementation must validate actual destruction too
int(4*componentCount*materialDurability*100)
round(baseMaxDamage*qualityModifier), minimum 1; average or non-quality uses base
hardness==0 ->0; else max(int(hardness*100*baseDecay),int(100*baseDecay/20),1)
no wear when item not damageable, block portable, creative player, hardness<=0, or tool strength<=1
held item bonus applies only if effective against target block
height delta outside [-0.5,0.5] contributes half of excess, capped [-1,1]; entity adjustment and separate item bonuses then apply
positive-hardness placement requires food energy unless creative
successful server-side noncreative placement adds min(hardness(0),20)*enduranceModifier hunger
road metadata 1, explosion, nonplayer use superclass; otherwise fortune=min(fortune,3), special probability 3/(12-2*fortune)
conditional special: 2/3 flint branch (1/16 full flint,15/16 chip); 1/3 mineral branch, successive 2/3 choices copper,silver,gold,obsidian,emerald,diamond,mithril, then adamantium remainder
copper/silver/mithril/adamantium become gold nuggets; obsidian/emerald/diamond become quartz shard
placed=no ordinary drop; swamp first 1/2 no drop; sequential 0.01 sapling then 0.05 stick then 0.005 fruit; oak jungle=orange else apple, jungle leaf=banana

gaps: legacy client/server full mining call chain
